question: Which channel had the highest ROAS and which campaign spent the most?

sql:
SELECT r.channel, r.roas FROM (WITH totals AS (
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.channel, c.objective, c.status, c.daily_budget,
       SUM(m.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(m.clicks) AS clicks,
       SUM(m.spend) AS spend, SUM(m.conversions) AS conversions, SUM(m.revenue) AS revenue
FROM campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN daily_metrics AS m
  ON c.id=m.campaign_id AND m.date BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY c.id
), scoped AS (SELECT * FROM totals), grouped AS (SELECT channel,SUM(impressions) AS impressions,SUM(clicks) AS clicks,SUM(spend) AS spend,SUM(conversions) AS conversions,SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM scoped GROUP BY channel) SELECT *,
1.0*revenue/NULLIF(spend,0) AS roas,
100.0*clicks/NULLIF(impressions,0) AS ctr,
100.0*conversions/NULLIF(clicks,0) AS conversion_rate
 FROM grouped) AS r ORDER BY r.roas desc NULLS LAST, r.channel LIMIT ?

SELECT r.name, r.spend FROM (WITH totals AS (
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.channel, c.objective, c.status, c.daily_budget,
       SUM(m.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(m.clicks) AS clicks,
       SUM(m.spend) AS spend, SUM(m.conversions) AS conversions, SUM(m.revenue) AS revenue
FROM campaigns AS c LEFT JOIN daily_metrics AS m
  ON c.id=m.campaign_id AND m.date BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY c.id
), scoped AS (SELECT * FROM totals) SELECT *,
1.0*revenue/NULLIF(spend,0) AS roas,
100.0*clicks/NULLIF(impressions,0) AS ctr,
100.0*conversions/NULLIF(clicks,0) AS conversion_rate
 FROM scoped) AS r ORDER BY r.spend desc NULLS LAST, r.name LIMIT ?
